releases.notes:
- Support an already-resolved structure layer containing both cached files and delegated vanilla resources.
- Add a shared operator-login notice hook with Minecraft permission checks in version adapters.

- Add structure resource operations shared by Minecraft 1.20.1, 1.21.1, 26.1.2 and 26.2.
- Scope structure preparation to vanilla template resource sources and release it when a server stops.
- Keep template initialization and reload hooks inside RinLib so dependent mods share one core implementation.
- Supply a named development jar for the Forge 1.20.1 profile alongside its runtime jar.

Validated on Minecraft 1.20.1 (Fabric/Forge), 1.21.1, 26.1.2 and 26.2 (Fabric/NeoForge). Eight packaged dedicated-server runs include startup, reload, restart, structure priority, corruption repair, isolated storage failures and operator/non-operator login notifications.

- Add shared Minecraft item registration, component and item serialization, player names and command sources.
- Add synchronous function callbacks that restore the surrounding command context after completion or failure.
- Provide matching Fabric and NeoForge builds for Minecraft 1.21.1, 26.1.2 and 26.2.

# RinLib 0.2.0

Stable shared-state primitives used by Shared Lootr 1.3.0.

- Fixed shared owner: `00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001`
- Generic shared-owner map get/put/contains/remove operations
- Sticky one-way boolean projection
- Normal loader mod artifacts; no source embedding into consumers
